serpent's.line: She lives no more, a serpent's in her room
stanza: Remove her, send the cheetahs to the tomb
Our war is over, our queen has met her doom
She lives no more, a serpent's in her room

serpent's.linePrev: And all their tearful words would turn back into steam
serpent's.line: But me, I'm a single cell, on a serpent's tongue
serpent's.lineNext: There's a muddy field where a garden was
stanza: But me, I'm a single cell, on a serpent's tongue
There's a muddy field where a garden was
And I'm glad you got away, but I'm still stuck out here
My clothes are soaking wet from your brother's tears
